'''Riyan Kiner's Hovel''' was a small hovel located on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was owned by a mentally unstable retired adventurer turned [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] named [[Riyan Kiner]]. From there, the insane crate-hating Riner attacked the crate manufacturing company [[Joben Crate Company]] and planted bombs at [[Hotel/Legends|hotels]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The retired explorer threatened even more carnage if the production of crates should continue. However, his plan was foiled by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for ''[[Corellia Times]]'' reporter [[Vani Korr]]. After disarming the bombs, the spacer tracked Riyan Kiner to his hovel and eventually killed him in the confrontation.<ref name="SWG:TMHP1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Riyan Kiner's Hovel was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:TMHP1" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Riyan Kiner's Hovel was added to the game with the update dubbed "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>
